recorded_from: Sonarr 4.0.20.3014, polling after the same torrent finished downloading
note: state is stalledUP, qBittorrent's own spelling of finished and not currently uploading, not pausedUP: this transfer reached State::Seeding rather than State::Paused. On the original run this torrent had no top level folder inside it, so content_path was identical to save_path, and Sonarr's importer refused to pull files out of a directory it could not tell apart from the category's shared base folder. That fix (every torrent gets a folder of its own) shipped without ever being re-run against a real Sonarr. It has now been: this exact body, byte for byte, is what a real Sonarr 4.0.20.3014 was actually sent when it polled this same torrent after the fix, and this time Sonarr's queue accepted content_path as distinct from save_path and moved on to importing. See harness/README.md for the full end-to-end run, including the real 'downloadFolderImported' history event that followed. This is no longer a corrected guess; it is what was recorded.
